Exact source, ordinary/mutual/nested construction rules, four accepted fixtures and the one-scalar reject/control pair are locally content-bound. Implementing and testing them produces a concrete upstream-ready patch package without weakening unresolved universal authority limits.
A local, tested Kiota production patch and PR draft is the most concrete maintenance output now feasible. Submission remains separately human-gated; no external write is authorized by this item.

The implementation reuses the exact archived Kiota APIs, Lean 4.33.0 construction algorithm, existing process supervisor and predecessor validators. No new method or network literature lookup is required before implementation.

The completed design removed the only semantic design blocker. Exact patch, review and launch bindings are local engineering stages inside the active item, while the reporting alternative still has unbound scientific inputs.

candidates.rationale: ACTIVE under a fresh committed work record and protocol. Exact source and fixtures are local; production edits are confined to a disposable materialization, launches require an independent patch review and exact supervised manifests, and external submission is forbidden.
PLANNED as a broader report-correctness study, but its exact six fixtures, expected transitive assumption sets, two observable report paths and staged integration protocol remain unbound.
